The Chinese characters for Xavier

As a transliteration, Xavier is usually written 泽维尔 (Zé wéi ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

尔

Origin and meaning

With Basque origins, Xavier is usually read as “new house, or bright”.

About the name Xavier

Saint Francis Xavier was a pioneering Jesuit missionary.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Xavier carries the meaning “new house, or bright” and looks striking in brush strokes.
